events.note:
Minerva Hanssen, age 90, of Summit, passed away on Monday, Nov. 20, 2017, at her winter home in Sun City West, Ariz.

Funeral services will be held Friday, Dec. 1 in Peoria, Ariz.

Minerva was born on Aug. 3, 1927, in Clayton, to Edward and Bertha Zelmer. They moved to a farm near Emery and on Sept. 4, 1945, Minerva was united in marriage to Lester Hanssen. They settled on a farm north of Watertown, where they have lived for the past 60 years wintering in Arizona, the last 24.

Minerva was an avid gardener and enjoyed spending time in the kitchen. You never left her home hungry. She loved spending time with family and friends and drop-in visitors were always welcome.

Minerva is survived by her husband, Lester; sister, Vivian (Elmer) Hanssen; brother, Daniel (Connie) Zelmer; children, Sherman (Elva) Hanssen of Orman Beach, Fla., Lloyd (Rosemarie) Hanssen of Peever, Curtis (Margaret) Hanssen of Summit and Forrest ”Butch” (Robin) Hanssen of Sioux Falls; eight grandchildren; and nine great-grandchildren.

Preceding her in death were her parents, two sisters, two brothers and one grandchild.

- Watertown Public Opinion November 29, 2017
